P.name: Break the Mold
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rell's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} equal to the sum of {{as|5% of her '''total''' armor}} and {{as|5% of her '''total''' magic resistance}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rell's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against non-{{tip|minions}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Break The Mold'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Each stack reduces the target's {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by 3% for a maximum of 15% reduction.
P.description3: '''Rell''' gains {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}} equal to the sum of resistances reduced from all afflicted enemies.
P.description4: ''Break the Mold'' will reduce the target's {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resistance}} by a minimum of {{pp|1.5 + (3-1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}.

Q.name: Shattering Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' thrusts her lance in the target direction, {{tip|lunge|lunging}} forward 100 units and destroying the damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} of all enemies hit (excluding the shields of {{tip|monsters}}) before dealing them {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.65}} seconds.
Q.description2: '''''Rell''' will not {{tip|lunge}} forward after the cast time if she was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} during it. She is also {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.35}} seconds after the cast time.''

W.name: Ferromancy: Crash Down
W.description: {{sbc|Passive - Mounted Alacrity:}} While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Mounted}}, she gains {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' becomes {{sbc|Dismounted}} and {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location over the cast time, granting herself a {{tip|shield}} that lasts until destroyed or casting ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}''. Upon arrival, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.8}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds. She will continue {{tip|dash|sliding}} forward another 320 units over {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Estimated}}, though not through terrain, affecting further enemies along her path.
W.leveling2:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|20 to 100}} {{as|(+ 11% '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
W.description3: While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, she can cast ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}''. Upon completing a {{si|Recall}} channel or respawning, '''Rell''' will automatically revert to {{sbc|Mounted}} form without casting the ability and reset ''{{ais|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
W.description4: ''This ability can be cast only while Rell is {{sbc|Mounted}}. '''Rell''' can cast {{ai|Magnet Storm|Rell}} during the dash, and is considered to be dismounted at the start of the cast time.''

W.name: Ferromancy: Mount Up
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, she gains {{sti|{{as|15% '''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|15% '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and {{sti|75 '''bonus''' attack range}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' becomes {{sbc|Mounted}}, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 2 seconds and empowering her next basic attack within {{fd|3.5}} seconds to have a {{fd|0.2}}-second cast time, gain {{sti|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}, and cause her to {{tip|dash|charge}} at the target's location. Upon arrival or collision of the charge, her basic attack deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target for {{fd|0.6}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|flings}} them 150 units over herself, though not through terrain, over {{fd|0.4}} seconds.
W.description3: While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Mounted}}, she can cast ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Crash Down|Rell}}''.
W.description4: ''Ferromancy: Mount Up {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Rell's''' basic attack timer. This ability can be cast only while '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}.''

E.name: Full Tilt
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' powers up herself and the target allied {{tip|champion}} for 3 seconds, both gaining {{as|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing the empowered ally or a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion.
E.description2: Additionally, '''Rell's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Shattering Strike|Rell}}'' within 5 seconds creates an explosion around {{tt|the target|See Notes}} that deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, capped at {{pp|150 + (300-150)/17*(x-1) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|structures}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|5 to 7}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
E.description3: If cast without a valid target, or [[self-targeted|self-cast]], ''Full Tilt'' will automatically target the closest allied champion in range.

R.name: Magnet Storm
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' erupts with magnetic fury, {{tip|airborne|pulling}} nearby enemies {{tt|inward|to a ring 225 units around Rell, but minimum 100 pull distance}} and creating a gravitational field around her for the next 2 seconds that deals {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to nearby enemies and {{tip|kinematics|drags}} them towards her.
R.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|150/8 to 350/8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110/8}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}}}}
